summary: Right lower zone shows new increased hazy opacity with loss of vessel definition on current compared to a more lucent right base on prior, matched by rib and diaphragm landmarks; left lung with pacemaker appears unchanged.

findings.rationale: Prior right lower lobe shows visible vascular markings through a relatively lucent base; current shows denser, hazier opacity obscuring the same vessels at the same rib level, suggesting new/worsening consolidation. Portable AP exposure and rotation differences are a caveat.
